body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one unattended object, doorway, or 1-unit area within 4 units. Prepare it to interfere with the next creature that uses or enters it.

surges.html: When this card's Contingency triggers against a creature, that creature burns 1 die.
Repeat one non-damage utility effect of this Action on a second eligible target.

rider.title: TRAP CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: A creature uses or crosses the prepared object or area. Effect: Compare Resolve against Fortitude; on a success, make it Exposed and stop its current movement.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
